Volume
Compared to the last report all forages sold steady.  Demand was moderate to good. Some previously spoken loads of hay have been turned 
back by out of state buyers due to the increase of diesel fuel and freight charges they can not afford to ship the hay halfway across the USA 
anymore. These buyers like to purchase WY high elevation hay as its put up right with no bleaching and the horse owners on the other end 
that purchase the hay love the color and quality of the product. These customers have been buying hay from western WY for 
10
 or more 
years.  On a positive note, there has been some rain showers across the state with some snow reported in certain areas. Everyone is very 
thankful for any moisture that has come their way!
